name: Modules.BLE.DescriptorRequest
summary: A request that uses the Attribute Protocol (ATT).
description:
The class represents Attribute Protocol (ATT) read and write requests from remote central devices
(represented by Central objects). Remote centrals use these ATT requests to read and write descriptor's
values on local peripherals (represented by PeripheralManager objects). Local peripherals, on the other
hand, use the properties of Request objects to respond to the read and write requests appropriately,
using the respondToDescriptorRequest() method of the PeripheralManager class.

properties.name: central
properties.summary: The central that originated the request.

properties.name: descriptor
properties.summary: The descriptor whose value will be read or written.

properties.name: offset
properties.summary: The offset given for the value

properties.name: responseNeeded
properties.summary: If the remote device requires a response.
properties.description: If this property is true then user need to call respondToRequest method.

properties.name: value
properties.summary: The data being read or written.

methods.name: updateValue
methods.summary: update the data of value field

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary: Titanium.Buffer object to update data on value
